finding.headline: "The Solo-Stroller Newbie"
finding.problem: "Back home Mama would just take the baby and go. Here I cry trying to figure out the carrier straps. I've left the house alone zero times."
finding.person: UK/US-based diaspora mum (baby 8 wks) whose own mother's visitor visa was refused; no one locally to show her how to buckle baby into carrier/car seat and walk out the door alone.
finding.competition_notes: See RESEARCH BASE section of source report.

disposition.rationale: Report assigns: "Standalone — pairs with Niche 1 as a "Solo Outing System" but different avatar (visa-denied).". Verdict: PASSES (met 4/5 strong).
